name: Alex
text: Yes, I do — as a matter of fact, I can show you mine.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I've worn watches since primary school, because at school I couldn't use my phone, but I still needed to know the time, so my mom bought me one.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Back then it was just a simple watch — mechanical or battery-powered, just for telling the time.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But now I wear a smartwatch, and it has different functions — not just time, but also heart rate.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: When I work out at the gym, I can see how many calories I'm actually burning, even if it's not that accurate.
